content.text:
Here is a complete, structured answer based on current official Belgian/Brussels sources (November 2026).

## 1. Where, within what deadline, and for how long

**Jobseeker registration (first step, mandatory before any benefit claim):**
Since you reside in the Brussels-Capital Region, you must register with **Actiris**.

citations.cited_text: dans les huit jours qui suivent votre premier jour de chômage · auprès du service régional pour l’emploi de votre Région · pour la Flandre : VDAB · po...
citations.title: Vous devenez chômeur. Et maintenant ? - Caisse auxiliaire de ...

content.text: You must register within the eight days that follow your first day of unemployment, with the regional employment service of your Region — for the Brussels-Capital Region: Actiris.
Since you worked your full notice period (not a "non-worked" notice), the 8-day deadline (not the 2-month deadline for non-worked notice) applies to you.

citations.cited_text: Les travailleurs en préavis **non presté** ont un délai **maximum de 2 mois** pour venir s’inscrire comme chercheur d’emploi.
citations.title: Qui peut s’inscrire ou se réinscrire et quand ?

content.text: Workers on non-worked notice have a maximum period of 2 months to register as jobseekers

— but this does not apply to you since you worked the notice.

If you miss the 8-day deadline, you don't lose your rights entirely, but

citations.cited_text: Si ce délai n'est pas respecté, vous pourrez seulement percevoir des allocations à partir du jour de votre inscription.
citations.title: Comment devez-vous introduire une demande après une occupation?

content.text: you will only be able to receive benefits from the day of your registration.

**Benefit application:**
You apply with a payment body (CAPAC/HVW or a union fund) —

citations.cited_text: Pour faire ta demande de chômage, tu dois envoyer à la CAPAC : - Le formulaire C4 (fourni par ton employeur) - Le formulaire C1 - Une preuve d’inscrip...
citations.title: Comment s'inscrire au chômage en Belgique ? - Bruxelles-J

content.text: you must send the CAPAC: the C4 form (provided by your employer), the C1 form, and proof of registration as a jobseeker (with Actiris if domiciled in Brussels)
. There is no strict deadline for submitting the claim itself to your payment body, but

citations.cited_text: Quand tu auras introduit ta demande, ton organisme de paiement aura alors un délai d’un mois pour transmettre ton dossier à l’ONEm. Ensuite, l’ONEm au...

content.text: your payment body then has a one-month deadline to transmit your file to the ONEM, which itself has 2 months to take a decision

En ce qui concerne les allocations de chômage, elles sont  versées après vérification par l’ ONEM. Cela peut prendre 2 à 4 semaines selon le dossier.

If accepted,

citations.title: S'inscrire au chômage

content.text: you will be compensated starting from the date of your request

, provided you registered on time.

**Duration of benefits — important recent reform:**
Belgium's traditionally unlimited unemployment benefit system has changed.

# Le point sur la réforme de l'assurance chômage en Belgique
Le régime d’assurance chômage belge, jusqu’ici atypique en Europe en raison de sa durée d...
citations.title: Le point sur la réforme de l'assurance chômage en Belgique

content.text: The Belgian unemployment insurance system, previously atypical in Europe due to its unlimited duration of compensation, was significantly modified by the law of 18 July 2025, and the main measure of the reform is the limitation of the duration of unemployment benefit payments to 2 years.
Concretely, under the new rules applicable from 1 March 2026:

citations.cited_text:
## Nouvelle réglementation à partir du 1er mars 2026
- Les **allocations de chômage complet** seront limitées à un maximum de 24 mois (12 mois de droi...
citations.title: Réforme du chômage : qu'est-ce qui change ?| Office national ...

content.text: full unemployment benefits are limited to a maximum of 24 months (12 months of base entitlement and 12 additional months depending on professional background)
. More precisely,

citations.cited_text: Toute personne ayant travaillé au moins un an au cours des trois dernières années pourra prétendre à un an d’allocations. Ensuite, chaque période supp...
citations.title: Réforme du chômage: après des mois de manifestations et de grogne, ...

content.text: anyone who has worked at least one year in the last three years can claim one year of benefits, and each additional period of four months worked opens a right to one more month of benefits, within the absolute limit of two years.

Given your 4 years of full-time salaried work, you should qualify for close to (or at) the 24-month maximum, but you should confirm your exact entitlement with Actiris/your payment body given the reform's transitional rules.

If your first claim is refused,

citations.cited_text: Si le bureau de chômage refuse ta demande d’allocations de chômage, tu peux introduire un recours devant le tribunal du travail dans un délai de 3 moi...
citations.title: Comment s'inscrire au chômage en Belgique ? - Bruxelles-J

content.text: you can lodge an appeal before the labour tribunal (tribunal du travail) within 3 months.

## 2. Responsible bodies

- **Jobseeker registration**: **Actiris** (the Brussels-Capital Region's public employment service) — the only competent regional body for residents of the Brussels-Capital Region.
- **Benefit entitlement decision**: **ONEM/RVA** (the National Employment Office), the federal body that examines and decides on your right to unemployment benefits.
- **Benefit payment**: a **payment institution** of your choice — either the **CAPAC/HVW** (the public auxiliary payment fund) or a **trade union** (FGTB, CSC, CGSLB) acting as payment agency.

## 3. How to follow vocational training without losing benefits

You remain a registered jobseeker and keep benefits by obtaining a **"dispense de disponibilité" (availability waiver)** from Actiris:

-

- This waiver covers, among others,

citations.cited_text:
- Votre formation ou stage :

- Importantly,

citations.cited_text: **Vous suivez une formation professionnelle agréée ?** Vous recevez dans ce cas automatiquement une dispense.

For other types of studies/training/internships, you must actively request the waiver from Actiris.

content.text: this can be done via a "Dutch-speaking professional project" with partner VDAB, open to all motivated jobseekers wanting to learn Dutch, regardless of their current level.

**Practical sequence**: (1) register with Actiris within 8 days → (2) submit C1/C4 to CAPAC or your union within a reasonable time (ideally immediately) → (3) once registered and your benefit file is submitted, identify a training via Bruxelles Formation (French) or VDAB Brussel (Dutch) → (4) request the "dispense de disponibilité" from Actiris **before** the training starts (automatic for approved vocational trainings) → (5) continue receiving benefits during the approved training period, with your overall benefit entitlement period being extended/frozen accordingly.

## 4. Official sources

- ONEM/RVA — official pages on registering after employment, obligations of unemployed persons, and the 2025 reform (onem.be)
- Actiris — official pages "Qui peut s'inscrire et quand," "Me former," "Chèques langues," "Projet professionnel néerlandophone," and "Dispenses" (actiris.brussels)
- CAPAC/HVW — "Vous devenez chômeur. Et maintenant?" and "Chômage complet après une interruption/occupation" (hvw-capac.fgov.be)
- Bruxelles Formation — official training information (bruxellesformation.be / bruxelles-j.be guide)
- VDAB Brussel — schakelsnaarwerk.be (Dutch-language training for Brussels residents)
- Unédic analysis of the Belgian reform and RTBF/press coverage of the July 2025 law limiting unemployment benefits to 2 years, effective progressively from 2026

Given the ongoing reform (with a constitutional court challenge recently decided in September 2026 per union sources), I recommend confirming your exact benefit duration and entitlement conditions directly with Actiris, your chosen payment body (CAPAC or a union), and checking the latest ONEM updates, as transitional rules can affect individual situations differently.
